description: This file defines the LinearHistory class, which manages a chronological list of Checkpoint objects, including adding, retrieving, deleting checkpoints, and maintaining their state.

classes.name: LinearHistory
classes.description: A class that manages a list of checkpoints with functionalities to add, delete, retrieve, and iterate over checkpoints, maintaining state persistently.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a checkpoint by its ID.

methods.name: getParents
methods.description: Yields parent checkpoints of a given checkpoint ID.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all checkpoints.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of checkpoints.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new checkpoint with specified ID and label.
